articles.title: Anatomy of a .strat file
articles.summary: A .strat file is plain text split into sections. [Settings] holds the run configuration, [DO NOT EDIT] stores the resolution the strategy was recorded at, and [Steps] holds one command per line, executed top to bottom. [Info] is optional and only describes the strategy in the macro list.

articles.title: All .strat [Settings] keys
articles.summary: The configuration the macro reads before a run starts. Unknown keys are ignored, and any key left out falls back to the default shown here.

articles.title: All .strat [Info] keys
articles.summary: Optional description shown on the strategy card inside the macro. Nothing here changes how the run is played, so it is safe to edit freely.

articles.title: SpawnTower command
articles.summary: Places a tower from the hotbar on the map and gives it an id. Every later command that touches this tower refers to it by that id.

articles.title: UpgradeTower command
articles.summary: Buys upgrades for a tower that is already placed. The macro opens the tower panel, waits until the upgrade is affordable and confirms each one.

articles.title: SellTower command
articles.summary: Sells a placed tower and frees its spot. The id stops being usable by later commands.

articles.title: CloneTower command
articles.summary: Uses the Hologram ability to place a copy of an existing tower at a new spot.

articles.title: BrawlerReposition command
articles.summary: Moves a placed Brawler to a new spot using its reposition ability.

articles.title: EnforcerReposition command
articles.summary: Uses the Helicopter Reposition ability of a top path Enforcer to carry another placed tower to a new spot.

articles.title: ActivateEnforcerVan command
articles.summary: Presses the SWAT Van keybind of a bottom path Enforcer. The strategy needs a bottom path Enforcer at level 5 or higher, otherwise the step is skipped.

articles.title: ActivateRaiseTheDead command
articles.summary: Presses the Raise the Dead keybind, which revives the Necromancer skeletons.

articles.title: ChangeTargets command
articles.summary: Opens the tower panel and cycles its targeting until it matches the target asked for.

articles.title: SetDJTrack command
articles.summary: Selects a track on the DJ Booth. The strategy has to place a tower with the id DJ first.

articles.title: ToggleAutoskip command
articles.summary: Presses the in-game autoskip toggle once. Use it to turn wave skipping off for a hard wave and on again afterwards.

articles.title: Click command
articles.summary: Clicks a point on screen. Useful for buttons the other commands do not cover.

articles.title: Send command
articles.summary: Holds a keyboard key down for a set time, then releases it. This is what the input recorder writes for movement and ability keys.

articles.title: Sleep command
articles.summary: Waits before running the next step. This is how a strategy lines up with the waves.

articles.title: Commander command
articles.summary: Tells the macro a Commander is in the loadout so it handles the Call of Arms ability during the run. The recorder adds this line by itself when it sees a Commander.
